text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Postal (Parcel Airmail Rates) Rules. Rates for parcels sent by air

The rates for parcels sent by air to the countries specified in the first column of the Schedule shall be such as are set opposite to the names of such countries in the second and third columns of the Schedule respectively.
Parcels exceeding twenty two pounds in weight may not be sent by air mail parcel post. (rule 2) For every additional ½ lb $2.00 0.90 ¢ $2.00 0.90 ¢
